description: This PHP class implements a stream decorator for inflating deflate or gzipped content by leveraging PHP's zlib.inflate filter. It reads and skips the gzip header, converts streams to PHP resources, applies the inflate filter, and wraps the resource back into a Guzzle stream for further use.

classes.name: InflateStream
classes.description: A stream decorator class that inflates gzipped or deflated data streams using PHP's zlib.inflate filter. It handles stream header skipping, header parsing, and stream resource management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an InflateStream by processing an input StreamInterface, skipping gzip headers, and applying the inflate filter to the underlying stream resource.

methods.name: getLengthOfPossibleFilenameHeader
methods.description: Detects and measures the length of a potential filename header in the gzip stream, reading until a null byte if a filename is present.
